problem.en: Fill in: "This is Riya's pen. It is __."
problem.hi: भरो: "This is Riya's pen. It is __."

steps.en: Riya is a girl; on its own we use "hers".
steps.hi: Riya लड़की है; अकेले "hers" लगता है।

steps.en: The tail belongs to the dog → its.

question.en: Fill in: "Is this bag yours or __?" (my/mine)

intro.en: Personal pronouns stand for people and things (I, he, they). Possessive words show who owns something: my, your, his, her, its, our, their (before a noun) and mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs (on their own).
intro.hi: व्यक्तिवाचक सर्वनाम लोगों और चीज़ों के लिए आते हैं (I, he, they)। स्वामित्व बताने वाले शब्द बताते हैं कि चीज़ किसकी है: my, your, his, her, its, our, their (संज्ञा से पहले) और mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs (अकेले)।
